title: Project Title: Investigation of Inflammatory Mechanisms in Skin Cells of Women and Men
summary:
Rationale for the Need for Human Trials: Animal experiments are insufficient for investigating molecular mechanisms in the skin, as metabolism in humans and mice differs significantly.
Mouse experiments are well-suited as preclinical models for elucidating fundamental mechanisms; nevertheless, human data are always necessary to enable the translation of animal data into clinical practice.
Furthermore, in patients, it is possible to analyze inter-individual differences in molecular mechanisms Primary keratinocytes from blepharoplasty . This is the only way to ensure that effective individualized therapeutic approaches can be developed.
